<script setup>
import { ref, watch, onMounted } from 'vue'
import axios from 'axios'
import { ElMessage } from 'element-plus'

const props = defineProps({
  modelValue: Boolean
})
const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue', 'refresh'])

const visible = ref(false)
const form = ref({ networkName: '' })
const networkNames = ref([])

const fetchNetworkNames = async () => {
  try {
    const res = await axios.get('/network/list')
    networkNames.value = Object.keys(res.data)
  } catch (err) {
    ElMessage.error('获取网络列表失败')
  }
}

const openDialog = () => {
  fetchNetworkNames()
  visible.value = true
}

const closeDialog = () => {
  visible.value = false
  form.value.networkName = ''
}

const submitDelete = async () => {
  if (!form.value.networkName) {
    ElMessage.warning('请选择网络名称')
    return
  }
  try {
    await axios.delete(`/network/delete/${form.value.networkName}`)
    ElMessage.success('删除成功')
    emit('refresh')
    closeDialog()
  } catch (err) {
    ElMessage.error('删除失败')
  }
}

// 暴露方法给父组件使用
defineExpose({
  openDialog
})
</script>
